faces.name: Satoshi
faces.blurb: The default of the current portfolio look — neutral, tight, slightly warm.

faces.name: Switzer
faces.blurb: Helvetica's proportions with the coldness taken out. Enormously used.

faces.name: General Sans
faces.blurb: Geometric skeleton, humanist details. Reads well very large.

faces.name: Cabinet Grotesk
faces.blurb: Studio-grotesk with cut terminals — built to be set as a headline.

faces.name: Clash Display
faces.blurb: The display face of this whole aesthetic. Tight, confident, a little brutal.

faces.name: Supreme
faces.blurb: Quirky neo-grotesk; the R and S have real personality at size.

faces.name: Ranade
faces.blurb: High contrast for a sans. Closest here to a serif's modulation.

faces.name: Nippo
faces.blurb: Geometric, wide, low-contrast. Very architectural.

faces.name: Chillax
faces.blurb: Rounded geometric, and by some way the closest of all of them to Friz.

faces.name: Technor
faces.blurb: Squarish and technical — the most opinionated thing in this list.

faces.name: Bespoke Sans
faces.blurb: Compact grotesk with flat-sided bowls.

faces.name: Pally
faces.blurb: Humanist with a calligraphic memory; the closest here in spirit to Friz.

faces.name: Geist
faces.blurb: Vercel's face. Precise, contemporary, engineered rather than drawn.

faces.name: Instrument Sans
faces.blurb: Everywhere in 2024–25 design work, and deservedly.

faces.name: Host Grotesk
faces.blurb: Newer Google release; a clean editorial grotesk.

faces.name: Funnel Display
faces.blurb: Subtly flared stems — the only face here that nods at Friz's wedges.

faces.name: Bricolage Grotesque
faces.blurb: Deliberately irregular. The most art-directed option that is still readable.

faces.name: Space Grotesk
faces.blurb: The awwwards workhorse. Mono-derived, quirky R.

faces.name: Syne
faces.blurb: Art-institution face; the widths fight each other on purpose.

faces.name: Gabarito
faces.blurb: Friendly geometric with a strong single-storey feel at scale.

faces.name: Anybody
faces.blurb: Width axis built in — the most flexible here if the measure changes.

faces.name: Unbounded
faces.blurb: Very wide, very geometric. Closest to Friz's wide O of anything here.

faces.name: Sora
faces.blurb: Low-contrast geometric with generous round caps.

faces.name: Outfit
faces.blurb: Pure geometric — circles and lines, nothing else.
